title: 15th-16th century explorers' accounts of Amazon cities

tellings.quote: that you've heard 16th, 15th century explorers seeing these things driving your research, and then you corroborating those stories.

plain: Talking with the writer Graham Hancock, the podcast host Jesse Michels mentions old reports from European explorers of the 1400s and 1500s who said they saw large settlements in the Amazon rainforest. Michels says these stories helped drive Hancock's research and that Hancock's work then backed them up. If true, it would mean the Amazon once held cities far bigger than people usually imagine.
